profile.summary: Anti-Bias Leaders ECE (Early Childhood Education) is an organization that supports anti-bias education in early childhood programs. It produces films and educational materials and offers workshops, keynote talks, curriculum review, mini-courses, film screenings and consulting for educators and early childhood programs.
